section_a_honors_and_awards.description: Distinguished awards celebrating scholarly achievement and institutional contribution in Sanskrit.

awards.awarding_body: Ministry of Education, Government of India
awards.eligibility: Eminent senior scholars possessing significant published work and teaching contributions over decades.
awards.recent_awardees: Prominent traditional pandits and university professors of high standing
awards.contribution_summary: Recognizes lifelong preservation of traditional text interpretations and outstanding teaching.

awards.awarding_body: Sahitya Akademi, India's National Academy of Letters
awards.eligibility: Authors of outstanding original creative works written in the Sanskrit language.
awards.recent_awardees: Contemporary Sanskrit poets, playwrights, and modern storytellers
awards.contribution_summary: Encourages the continuous development of Sanskrit as a living language of creative literature.

section_b_scholarships_and_funding.description: Financial resources supporting students, independent researchers, and faculty.

funding_opportunities.provider: Indian Council for Cultural Relations (ICCR), Government of India
funding_opportunities.eligibility: Established professors and specialized researchers in Sanskrit, Indology, and philosophy.
funding_opportunities.deadline: Rolling / Specific to bilateral institutional notifications
funding_opportunities.amount: Covers international travel allowances, institutional honorariums, and living stipends
funding_opportunities.region_restrictions: Applicable for deployment at global partner universities (e.g., in Mauritius, South America, or Europe).

funding_opportunities.scholarship_fellowship_name: Central Sanskrit University National Scholarship Scheme
funding_opportunities.provider: Central Sanskrit University (CSU), funded by the Ministry of Education
funding_opportunities.eligibility: Regular students scoring above minimum percentage thresholds in core Sanskrit exams at accredited institutions.
funding_opportunities.amount: Tiered monthly stipends helping offset institutional education expenses
funding_opportunities.duration: Renewable for the standard duration of the specific degree program
funding_opportunities.region_restrictions: Restricted to students pursuing regular academic pathways within India.
